# pve_node_disk_directory (Data Source)

Looks up a single PVE-managed directory storage on a Proxmox VE node (`GET /nodes/{node}/disks/directory`, matched on the `/mnt/pve/<name>` mount path).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_node_disk_directory" "backup" {
  node = "pve1"
  name = "backup"
}

output "backup_mount" {
  value = {
    path     = data.pve_node_disk_directory.backup.path
    device   = data.pve_node_disk_directory.backup.device
    type     = data.pve_node_disk_directory.backup.type
    unitfile = data.pve_node_disk_directory.backup.unitfile
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Storage identifier. PVE mounts the directory under `/mnt/pve/<name>`; the listing is matched on that path.
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node to query.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) The mounted device.
- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the node name.
- `options` (String) The mount options.
- `path` (String) The mount path (e.g. `/mnt/pve/backup`).
- `type` (String) The filesystem type. One of `ext4` or `xfs`.
- `unitfile` (String) The path of the systemd mount unit.
